  function level2AssetsReady(){
    return Object.values(HD_L2).every(img => img && img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0);
  }
  let level2PreloadPromise = null;
  function preloadLevel2HD(){
    if(level2AssetsReady()) return Promise.resolve(true);
    if(level2PreloadPromise) return level2PreloadPromise;
    level2PreloadPromise = Promise.all(Object.values(HD_L2).map(img => new Promise(resolve => {
      if(img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) return resolve(true);
      const done = () => resolve(true);
      const fail = () => resolve(false);
      img.addEventListener('load', done, {once:true});
      img.addEventListener('error', fail, {once:true});
      if(img.decode) img.decode().then(done).catch(()=>{});
    }))).then(results => results.every(Boolean) && level2AssetsReady()).catch(()=>false);
    return level2PreloadPromise;
  }
  preloadLevel2HD();
  function isLevel2HD(){
    return state && state.mode !== 'endless' && state.levelIndex === 1;
  }
  function drawLevel2BackdropHD(){
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    if(!drawImageCover(HD_L2.bg, Math.sin(state.time*.12)*8, Math.cos(state.time*.10)*6, 1)){
      ctx.fillStyle = skyGradient('garden'); ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    }
    // Gentle parallax only; the base art already contains the world, keeping gameplay readable.
    drawCloudLayer(state.farClouds, 'garden', .42);
    state.farIslands.forEach(i=>drawIsland(i,'garden',true));
    drawCloudLayer(state.midClouds, 'garden', .58);
    state.nearIslands.forEach(i=>drawIsland(i,'garden',false));
    drawWind();
    drawCloudLayer(state.nearClouds, 'garden', .72);
    drawBottomFog();
  }
